name: dbt MCP Server
summary: dbt Labs' official MCP server exposing dbt Core, Fusion and dbt Platform context to agents: SQL, Semantic Layer metrics, Discovery lineage and CLI.
description: Tool groups include SQL (`execute_sql`, `text_to_sql`), Semantic Layer (`list_metrics`, `query_metrics`, ...), Discovery (`get_lineage`, `get_model_health`, `get_node_details`, ...) and dbt CLI commands. Each release also ships an experimental `dbt-mcp.mcpb` bundle. PyPI `dbt-mcp` (Python >=3.12,<3.14); latest GitHub release v2.8.0 (2026-10-13).
